_why_this_file_exists: EVS-5. Chapter 1 was a stack of pages: a scene named its locations as prose and nothing connected them. Canon builds the Bimaristan in FOUR STACKED TIERS and says the fourth is the point — 'The Underworks make every visible function possible. They are also a physical representation of hidden dependencies and neglected maintenance.' Chapter 1's whole mystery is two supplies shown as independent on the official map passing through one chamber in that layer. A place model that cannot express the tiers cannot express the chapter.
_what_is_not_here: Any image. The reviewed design package required by EVS-5 section 3 does not exist — eleven v0.1 review concepts pending owner review, no plan or cutaway asset, no state frames, no crops, no alt text, no weight budgets, and Q10 (the inclusion reviewer) open. So this is the SEMANTIC place model only. The visual binding gate is held, not passed, and no CSS drawing, handcrafted SVG, emoji or placeholder box stands in for the missing art.

tiers.what: Senior governance, the main signal tower, ceremonial spaces, and the Measure. Authority, strategy, reputation — and the danger of distance from frontline conditions.
Most care areas, teaching halls, laboratories, residential courts, kitchens, gardens and workshops. Where formal systems meet everyday human life.
The main gates, arrival courts, stores, transport yards and high-volume care. Crowded, adaptive, rich in informal knowledge — and often seen from above as a flow problem.
An older network of cisterns, conduits, pressure chambers, heat vaults, waste channels, sealed passages and forgotten junctions, below all rings.

The existing three assets are 121-159 KB derivatives from 2.5-3.3 MB masters. A cutaway carries far more detail and may want a larger derivative AND a small one, which is a decision that belongs with the design package rather than ahead of it. One budget is declared so the slot is complete; a second size is a change to make when there is an image to measure.
